name: chipotle_find_menu_item_price
intent: Find the price of a menu item in the Chipotle app.
description: Sets the preferred pickup location by ZIP code, navigates to the menu category containing the requested item, opens the item, and returns its displayed price.
patterns: find the price of a menu item
how much does a menu item cost
check the price of this item
what is the price of that side

inputs.name: zip_code
inputs.description: ZIP code for the preferred pickup location.

inputs.name: menu_item
inputs.description: Menu item whose price should be found.

steps.intent: Open pickup or delivery options to set the pickup location.
Go back to dismiss the blocking location-data disclosure.
Go back to dismiss the blocking location permission prompt.
Type {{zip_code}} into the City, State, or ZIP search field.
Go back to return to the home screen.
Open pickup or delivery options again to set the pickup location.
Go back to dismiss the blocking location-data disclosure.
Go back to dismiss the blocking location permission prompt.
Type {{zip_code}} into the City, State, or ZIP search field.
Go back to clear the blocking prompt and return to the home screen.
Open pickup or delivery options to set the pickup location before viewing the menu.
Go back to dismiss the blocking location-data disclosure.
Type {{zip_code}} into the City, State, or ZIP search field.
Type {{zip_code}} into the correct City, State, or ZIP search field to find the pickup location.
Open the location list to choose a pickup location.
Select the pickup location that shows {{zip_code}}.
Confirm the selected pickup location.
Open the menu.
Scroll until the CHIPS & SIDES category is visible.
Open the CHIPS & SIDES category.
Open {{menu_item}} to view its price.
